summary: 3 repair target(s) are valid and should be applied by rewriting q2-q4 as neutral user questions.

items.title: 1. q2 embeds the proposed test strategy
items.rationale: The question should ask for the desired unit/e2e coverage boundary without embedding the proposed must/should answer.
items.evidence: draft.json qa entry q2 currently includes `must: unit tests` and `should: e2e tests`, matching the repair target.

items.title: 2. q3 embeds acceptance answers and internal detail
items.rationale: The question should ask which observable acceptance condition to require without preselecting `agent.call` or CLI wording.
items.evidence: draft.json qa entry q3 currently includes `agent.call` and a proposed should-level wording decision, matching the repair target.

items.title: 3. q4 embeds a non-goal instruction
items.rationale: The question should ask what review-test related changes are out of scope without embedding the non-goal as a must requirement.
items.evidence: draft.json qa entry q4 currently includes `must: この issue では...対象外`, matching the repair target.
